name: binary_fuse16_filter_contains
description: Tests if a Binary Fuse 16-bit filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: quotient_filter
description: Creates a Quotient filter by aggregating UBIGINT values. q is the number of quotient bits (controls capacity, ~2^q slots) and r is the number of remainder bits (controls false positive rate, ~2^-r). q + r must be <= 64. Returns a BLOB to probe with quotient_filter_contains.

name: quotient_filter
description: Merges Quotient filters (BLOBs produced by quotient_filter) into a single filter containing every value of the inputs. q and r size the merged filter; it uses the larger of these and each input's quotient and remainder bits, so q must leave room for all merged values. q + r must be <= 64.

name: quotient_filter_contains
description: Tests if a Quotient filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: binary_fuse8_filter
description: Creates a Binary Fuse 8-bit filter (~0.4% false positive rate) by aggregating UBIGINT values. Returns a BLOB to probe with binary_fuse8_filter_contains.

name: bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe
description: Probes a DuckDB-internal bloom filter (serialized as BLOB) for a value. The version parameter specifies which DuckDB hash algorithm to use. The version must be constant; a constant filter blob is parsed once at bind time, otherwise (e.g. a scalar subquery or a BLOB column) it is read per row. A NULL filter returns NULL. Multiple value arguments are combined for multi-key bloom filter probes.

examples.code: SELECT key_col, bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe('v2.0', (SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create('v2.0', 1024, bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', k)) FROM range(100) t(k)), key_col) AS maybe_present FROM range(98, 102) t(key_col);

WITH f AS (SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create('v2.0', 1024, bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', i, 'k' || i)) AS filter_blob FROM range(100) t(i)) SELECT col1, col2, bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe('v2.0', (SELECT filter_blob FROM f), col1, col2) AS maybe_present FROM (VALUES (1::BIGINT, 'k1'), (1, 'k2'), (200, 'k200')) t(col1, col2);

name: xor8_filter_contains
description: Tests if an Xor8 filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: xor16_filter_contains
description: Tests if an Xor16 filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: binary_fuse8_filter_contains
description: Tests if a Binary Fuse 8-bit filter may contain a value. Returns true if the value might be in the set (with possible false positives), or false if the value is definitely not in the set (no false negatives).

name: bitfilters_duckdb_hash
description: Computes the DuckDB-internal hash value for the given DuckDB version. The hash matches DuckDB's built-in hash() function for that version. Multiple values are combined using the version's CombineHash algorithm. Supported versions: v1.4.0-v1.4.4, v1.5.0, v1.5.1, v1.6.0, v2.0.

examples.code: SELECT bitfilters_duckdb_hash('v2.0', col1, col2) FROM tbl;

name: binary_fuse16_filter
description: Creates a Binary Fuse 16-bit filter (~0.0015% false positive rate) by aggregating UBIGINT values. Returns a BLOB to probe with binary_fuse16_filter_contains.

name: xor16_filter
description: Creates an Xor16 filter (16-bit fingerprints, ~0.0015% false positive rate) by aggregating UBIGINT values. Returns a BLOB to probe with xor16_filter_contains.

name: xor8_filter
description: Creates an Xor8 filter (8-bit fingerprints, ~0.4% false positive rate) by aggregating UBIGINT values. Returns a BLOB to probe with xor8_filter_contains.

name: bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_create
description: Creates a DuckDB-compatible bloom filter by aggregating pre-hashed UBIGINT values. Use bitfilters_duckdb_hash() to hash values first. The version and num_sectors (power of 2) are constants. Returns a BLOB that can be probed with bitfilters_duckdb_bloom_filter_probe.
